ko.headline: 1966년 달 군사기지를 진짜 설계했던 미 육군—왜 계획은 종이에서 끝났나
ko.hook: Project Horizon은 secret moon-base fantasy가 아니라 실제 1959 Army planning study였다. 하지만 real proposal과 built facility는 전혀 다른 상태다.

blocks.headingKo: Apollo보다 먼저 미 육군은 1966년 달에 12명 규모 military outpost를 계획했다
blocks.headingEn: Before Apollo, the U.S. Army Planned a 12-Person Military Lunar Outpost for 1966
blocks.textKo: U.S. Army historical record에 따르면 1959년 Army Ballistic Missile Agency는 Project HORIZON이라는 four-volume study를 완성했다. 목표는 manned lunar outpost를 1966년까지 구축하는 national program의 technical/logistical requirements를 제시하는 것이었다. 계획은 science-fiction memo가 아니라 Army의 formal planning study였고, Wernher von Braun의 team이 있던 ABMA가 중심역할을 했다.
blocks.textEn: U.S. Army historical records state that in 1959 the Army Ballistic Missile Agency completed a four-volume Project HORIZON study detailing a national program to establish a manned lunar outpost by 1966.

blocks.headingKo: 구상은 단순한 flag mission이 아니라 underground base와 대규모 logistics였다
blocks.headingEn: The Concept Was an Underground Base With Massive Logistics, Not a Flag-Planting Mission
blocks.textKo: Army history는 12-man outpost, underground living/storage areas, nuclear reactors, laboratories, hospital, communications center 등을 계획했다고 설명한다. crew는 space station rendezvous를 거쳐 moon으로 이동하는 architecture도 검토했다. sustainment에는 enormous cargo flow가 필요해 annual dozens of Saturn-class launches가 계산됐다. 즉 Project Horizon은 lunar base의 military utility와 logistics system 전체를 동시에 설계하려 한 proposal이었다.
blocks.textEn: Army history describes a 12-person outpost with underground living and storage areas, nuclear reactors, laboratories, a hospital, and communications facilities, supported by a large Saturn-launch logistics chain.

blocks.headingEn: Even the 1959 Estimate Exceeded Six Billion Dollars
blocks.textKo: Army historical summary는 program cost를 $6 billion 이상으로 예상했다고 기록한다. 당시 launch technology가 아직 초기단계였고 required launch cadence도 매우 높았다. schedule, budget, hardware maturity를 함께 보면 1966 operational base는 extremely aggressive plan이었다. document의 존재와 feasibility/approval을 구분해야 하는 이유다. 군이 연구했다는 사실이 곧 실행명령이 내려졌다는 뜻은 아니다.
blocks.textEn: Army history puts the expected cost above $6 billion and describes a very high launch cadence. The study was real, but a real study is not the same as an approved executable program.

blocks.headingKo: 미국 우주정책이 civilian NASA 중심으로 이동하면서 계획은 실행되지 않았다
blocks.headingEn: The Shift Toward Civilian NASA Leadership Left the Plan Unexecuted
blocks.textKo: Eisenhower administration이 civilian use of space를 강조하고 NASA가 만들어지면서 Army의 von Braun team과 major space-development responsibility가 NASA로 이전됐다. Project Horizon은 NASA로 넘어간 뒤 shelved됐다. 이후 Apollo는 lunar landing을 달성했지만 permanent armed Army base를 건설하지 않았다. Project Horizon은 ‘숨겨진 달기지가 완성됐다’가 아니라 냉전초기의 실제 military planning path that was abandoned인 셈이다.
blocks.textEn: As U.S. space policy shifted toward civilian NASA leadership, the von Braun team and major space responsibilities moved out of the Army. Project Horizon was transferred and shelved; Apollo later landed humans on the Moon but did not build the proposed Army outpost.

blocks.headingKo: 기밀 military plan이 존재했다는 사실은 secret lunar base가 실제 건설됐다는 증거가 아니다
blocks.headingEn: A Real Military Plan Is Not Evidence That a Secret Lunar Base Was Built
blocks.textKo: Project Horizon documents가 dramatic하기 때문에 secret-base narratives와 쉽게 연결된다. 그러나 proposal, engineering study, funded program, construction, operational facility는 서로 다른 state다. Army history 자체가 project가 never got off the ground라고 정리한다. ‘정부가 계획했다’는 사실을 정확히 인정하면서도 implementation evidence가 없다는 경계를 유지해야 한다.
blocks.textEn: The existence of dramatic planning documents makes Project Horizon easy to fold into secret-base narratives. But proposal, engineering study, funded program, construction, and operational facility are separate states; Army history says the project never got off the ground.

blocks.textKo:
확인됨: U.S. Army/ABMA는 1959년 Project Horizon four-volume study에서 1966년 12-person lunar military outpost를 제안했고 large Saturn logistics, underground facilities, nuclear power 등을 검토했다.

확인되지 않음: Project Horizon lunar base가 실제 건설·운영됐다는 evidence는 없다. Army history는 NASA 중심 정책전환 뒤 계획이 shelved됐다고 기록한다.
blocks.textEn:
Established: In 1959 the U.S. Army/ABMA Project Horizon study proposed a 12-person military lunar outpost by 1966, including large Saturn logistics, underground facilities, and nuclear power.

Not established: There is no evidence that a Project Horizon lunar base was built or operated; Army history records that the plan was shelved.

확인되지 않음: Project Horizon lunar base가 실제 건설·운영됐다는 evidence는 없다. Army history는 NASA 중심 정책전환 뒤 계획이 shelved됐다고 기록한다.

en.headline: The U.S. Army Really Designed a 1966 Lunar Military Base—Why Did It Stay on Paper?
en.hook: Project Horizon was a real 1959 Army planning study, not a fantasy—but a real proposal and a built lunar facility are very different things.

claims.statementKo: 1959 Army/ABMA는 1966 lunar outpost를 목표로 Project Horizon study를 완성했다.
claims.statementEn: In 1959 the Army/ABMA completed Project Horizon planning for a lunar outpost by 1966.

claims.statementKo: study는 12-person outpost, large Saturn logistics, underground facilities 등을 계획했다.
claims.statementEn: The study planned a 12-person outpost, large Saturn logistics, and underground facilities.

claims.statementKo: Project Horizon base가 실제로 건설·운영됐다는 주장은 Army history와 맞지 않는다.
claims.statementEn: Claims that a Project Horizon base was actually built or operated conflict with Army history stating the plan was shelved.
